dateAssessment: Working dates use YAML’s 1749 year and January 30 opening, consistent with two nights of flight before the next-day meeting explicitly dated February 2 (t01–t12). February 4 departure, approximately February 14 arrival, and March 8 afternoon are spoken (t19–t22). The final awakening is that night; whether it falls before or after midnight is unstated (t23). YAML’s March 9 end is compatible, not independently verified. The twenty-one-day downtime is approximate against those direct anchors; no extra day is inserted to make the interval match. Watches within the daytime conversations are estimates; Johar’s short arrival wait alone does not establish an afternoon clock.

watches.summary: January morning is spoken; January 30 comes from compatible YAML and the subsequent two-night flight.
Day turns to night; westward flight continues through the night to the next morning.
Sunrise places the ship approaching the southern Hara valley.
The Hara crossing occurs around dusk; another night of flight follows.
Predawn arrival; Sura replies after one minute and boards thirty minutes later.
Forty-five-minute news account, then Johar arrives twenty minutes after Sura leaves; morning is approximate.
The reply is received that evening; Sura’s after-dinner return and meditation are played through.
Tomorrow’s lunchtime appointment is kept; the DM explicitly dates the meeting February 2.
A couple-hour walk reaches the inn in afternoon; five-minute vision, forty-five-minute wait, then the remaining afternoon aboard ship.
Another day is spent settling matters and saying goodbye before the explicitly dated February 4 departure.
Departure is explicitly February 4; Tokra is immediately corrected to Tollen via Orenlas.
Eight-and-a-half days flying plus a day-and-a-half Orenlas stop culminate in arrival around February 14.
About three weeks of refit downtime lead to explicitly stated March 8, late afternoon.
The party sleeps, then wakes to screams; duration and the midnight crossing are unstated.
